whatTheyDo: A small bakery — daily bread, morning pastry, cakes to order, and wholesale deliveries to cafés — open Wednesday through Sunday until sold out.
hours: Wed–Sun, 7am until sold out. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

faqs.a: Wed–Sun, 7am until sold out. We post the morning's bake so you know what's in the case before you come.
Yes, order by 8pm and your bag is on the shelf with your name on it the next morning.

faqs.q: How much notice for a cake?
faqs.a: Two days for whole cakes. Tell us vanilla or chocolate and the size and we'll have it ready.

faqs.q: Do you sell wholesale to cafés?
faqs.a: We do, with standing morning deliveries of bread and pastry. Reach out and we'll talk about a route.
Not yet. We're a small flour-and-water shop and can't promise a clean kitchen for it. We'd rather be honest than careless.
